chunks.text: Python is a high-level programming language commonly used for automation, data analysis, machine learning, and backend development.
FastAPI is a Python web framework for building APIs. It supports request validation using type hints and Pydantic models.
PyMuPDF is a Python library that can open PDF files and extract text from individual pages.
Text embeddings represent text as numerical vectors. Semantically similar pieces of text tend to have vectors that are close together.
Cosine similarity compares the angle between two vectors. It is often used to rank text embeddings by semantic similarity.
Chunking splits a long document into smaller passages. Overlapping adjacent chunks can help preserve context across passage boundaries.
Streamlit is a Python framework for building interactive data applications and web interfaces with relatively little frontend code.
A language model can generate an answer using retrieved document passages as context. The application should indicate when the available evidence does not support an answer.
Pytest is a Python testing framework that supports test functions, fixtures, and assertions for automated testing.
A relational database stores structured data in tables and supports queries using a language such as SQL.
